item.title: Niizuma wa Mahou Shoujo
item.description:

  • ブランド: Terios
  • 発売日: 2008-06-30
  • スコア: 6.95/10 (6 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 新妻は魔法少女
  • 英語名: Niizuma wa Mahou Shoujo

あらすじ

Mai comes to the human world to make 100 people happy and thus become a full-fledged witch. She only has 5 people left! One day she gets spotted and prepares to erase memories as usual, but Koutarou sincerely encourages her instead of behaving creepy, so she does no such thing. Mai helps to solve Koutarou’s problems with classmates and teachers, but eventually the bond intensifies, and they start to live as a couple.

I’m Haruka. I’m studying hard to become a doctor. It’d be best if I could devote myself to my study, but I was in love with a boy. However, I couldn’t understand what he thought! item.title: Happy Princess
item.description:

  • ブランド: Terios

  • 日本語名: はっぴぃプリンセス
  • 英語名: Happy Princess

あらすじ

Tomoyuki is a high school student. He temporarily lives alone because his parents are abroad on business. But, he enjoys his life with his childhood friends and classmates.

One day, his peaceful life suddenly changes… Several girls appear in front of him, and tell him, “Choose one girl whom to marry!” He doesn’t know what’s going on, but his friends join this battle as well. Whom will he choose in the end…?

Main character has been in distant love relations with his childhood friend Chinatsu for a year. This summer he receives a letter inviting him to spend summer vacations together on a beach side. There three weeks are supposed to be paradise till father imposes prideful tutor to take care of protagonist in the absence of parents. Then suddenly distant relative who is like sister crushes in. Finally, there is a perverse wife living next door giving her embarrassing advice. Is it even possible to have time for Chinatsu in such circumstances?

あらすじ

Zeus was an omniscient and omnipotent god who ruled in Heaven where the gods lived. However, he was a pervert who had a wish to flirt with young angels, unbeknownst to his wife, Hera.

He came up with an idea to make use of the promotion examination which took place every three years. Three angels, Yu, Miki, and Chado-ko, came down to Earth to take the exams. When they began to work part-time jobs at the flower shop, the severe trials occurred one after another.

item.title: Elysion ~Eien no Sanctuary~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Terios
  • 発売日: 2000-08-10
  • スコア: 7.06/10 (26 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ELYSION ～永遠のサンクチュアリ～
  • 英語名: Elysion Eien no Sanctuary

别名

  • Elysion Eternal Sanctuary

あらすじ

As the story goes, an old man lives on an island in a mansion near the ocean. He’s reclusive, private and very wealthy. As the family physician, you are summoned to the island to care for the old man. The premise of the game introduction seems innocent and routine enough but the various characters you meet arouse suspicion and suspense amongst the different players inside the mansion.
